summary: Mixed-leaning-protective: gender identity added to the state constitution by 2022 ballot; “Most Protective”-adjacent tier. Above the national score 0.36.

sources.summary: Anti-trans legal risk assessment map, July 2026 update: places Nevada in the 'Low-Risk States' tier (the band directly below 'Most Protective'), specifically crediting Nevada (with Michigan) with 'fairly robust non-discrimination policies' while noting both 'fall short in ensuring healthcare equity and providing protections for incarcerated transgender individuals'; the update also rates the United States 'Do Not Travel' for transgender people after the 2025 federal rollbacks and grades Wisconsin as refraining from adult-targeting laws without specialising in protection.

NOTE: page content did not load at fetch time (only the equality-map site's navigation shell was retrieved); the underlying MAP Equality Map page tracks state-by-state bans on transgender people using public bathrooms and facilities according to their gender identity.
